# Coorg Tourism Info

> > Comprehensive guide to Coorg (Kodagu), Karnataka: homestays, Kodava culture, traditional cuisine, sacred sites, and tourism in India's coffee country.

Coorg Tourism Info is the definitive resource for exploring Kodagu District in Karnataka, featuring authentic homestay accommodations, deep dives into Kodava traditions and martial heritage, traditional recipes, and cultural insights into the indigenous people of this mountainous coffee-growing region.

## Key Topics

- Coorg (Kodagu)
- Kodava culture and people
- Madikeri
- Virajpet
- Coorg homestays
- Traditional Kodava cuisine
- Ceremonial daggers and jewelry
- Sacred groves and temples
- Kaveri river traditions
- Coffee estates
- Kodagu District tourism
- Traditional wedding customs
- P.T. Bopanna
- Kushalanagar

## Kodava Culture & Heritage

- [People](https://www.coorgtourisminfo.com/culture/people): Kodava people, culture, martial traditions and Hindu Kshatriya heritage
- [A Coorg Bride's Trousseau](https://www.coorgtourisminfo.com/blog/a-coorg-brides-trousseau): Kodava bridal trousseau: traditional jewelry, sarees and wedding customs
- [Men's Accessories](https://www.coorgtourisminfo.com/jewelleries/mens-accessories): Traditional Kodava men's accessories: ceremonial daggers and ornaments
- [Sacred Groves of Coorg](https://www.coorgtourisminfo.com/blog/sacred-groves-of-coorg-how-our-faith-is-conserving-nature-and-preserving-culture): Sacred groves in Kodagu: nature conservation through indigenous traditions
- [Theerthodbhava: Kodavas Are Children of Kaveri](https://www.coorgtourisminfo.com/blog/theerthodbhava-on-oct-17-kodavas-coorgs-are-children-of-kaveri): Theerthodbhava ceremony: Kodava connection to Kaveri river at Talakaveri

## Homestays & Accommodations

- [Madikeri](https://www.coorgtourisminfo.com/madikeri): Madikeri homestays and premium estate accommodations directory
- [Coorg Woodside Homestay](https://www.coorgtourisminfo.com/homestay/coorg-woodside-homestay): Coorg Woodside Homestay in Kattemadu Village near Madikeri
- [Neils Nest](https://www.coorgtourisminfo.com/homestay/neils-nest): Neils Nest heritage villa homestay in Kadnoor Village, Virajpet
- [Temple Side Homestay](https://www.coorgtourisminfo.com/homestay/temple-side-homestay): Temple Side Homestay in Highsudlur Village, Hudikeri area

## Traditional Coorg Cuisine

- [Coorg Lamb Masala and Paaputtu](https://www.coorgtourisminfo.com/recipie/deepthis-coorg-lamb-masala-and-paaputtu-by-p-t-bopanna): Traditional Coorg lamb masala and paaputtu rice cakes by Deepthi Pemmaiah
- [Nimmi's Crab Curry](https://www.coorgtourisminfo.com/recipie/nimmis-crab-curry-by-p-t-bopanna): Nimmi's crab curry recipe with Sri Lankan influences
- [Choute Pachchadi (Cucumber Chutney)](https://www.coorgtourisminfo.com/recipie/choute-pachchadi-cucumber-in-spiced-curd-cucumber-chutney-by-p-t-bopanna): Choute Pachchadi: traditional Kodagu cucumber curd chutney by Saroja Annaiah
- [Shilpa Bopanna's Chicken Cutlets](https://www.coorgtourisminfo.com/recipie/shilpa-bopannas-chicken-cutlets): Shilpa Bopanna's chicken cutlets recipe from Coorg cuisine

- [Union Govt Issues Fresh Guidelines to Define Homestays](https://www.coorgtourisminfo.com/blog/union-govt-issues-fresh-guidelines-to-define-homestays): New Union tourism ministry guidelines for homestay regulations in Coorg
